system.description:
The Oubliette is a prison of pure abysmal shadow with no opening — inescapable unless the jailer wills it. The victim seems drawn down into a pool of darkness that ripples once and falls still.

Spend five Willpower Traits and win a Mental Challenge that the victim resists with her Physical Traits. She is then encased until you release her or until sunlight touches the portion of the Oubliette remaining in the physical realm, and you may hold only one Oubliette at a time. Inside is a frigid, unlit, unventilated sphere just large enough to touch both walls with outstretched arms. A mortal suffocates in a number of minutes equal to her Physical Traits. A Cainite may use no power of any Discipline in which she lacks an Ascendant or Methuselah power, but the calm isolation grants her two bonus Traits on any Mental Challenge she makes there — unless the Oubliette preys upon a phobia of hers.
system.duration: Until released or touched by sunlight
